title: Cebu Marathon 2027 Review: A Dedicated Race in the Queen City of the South
meta_description: Cebu Marathon 2027 review: January 10 in Cebu City -- a dedicated, standalone marathon distinct from the MILO and Trilogy Run series legs.
dek: Set for 10 January 2027, this is a standalone Cebu Marathon -- distinct from the MILO Marathon's Cebu leg and the Sante Barley Trilogy's Cebu legs covered elsewhere in this research -- with its own dedicated organisation and website.
verdict: The Cebu Marathon is genuinely its own event, separate from the several other Cebu-based races covered throughout this research batch (MILO Marathon Cebu Leg, PalawanPay Trilogy Cebu Leg, Sante Barley Trilogy Cebu Leg 3). It has its own dedicated organisation and long-standing domain (cebumarathon.com.ph), suggesting an independent, established operation rather than a leg of a larger national series. Four distances (5K to full marathon) give it standard broad accessibility. Registration status for 2027 wasn't yet confirmed at the time of this research.

paragraphs: Cebu City has repeatedly demonstrated the ability to handle large-field races throughout this research batch, most notably the MILO Marathon's Cebu Leg, which drew over 24,000 runners in a record 2019 edition.
